incremental_reuse.reason: The read-path difference only maps detected stale-source pending mutations to HTTP503. Frozen resource inputs never enter that branch. Latest SQLite/MySQL stale-source regression passed. Three chat background files are not executed by synthetic resource fixtures and are covered by separate current-source background tests and live observations.

memory_sampling: Independent 5-second RSS sampler; first and last 5-minute medians; peak includes warmup.
load_boundary: Shared aggregate envelope on a busy development host. Auxiliary diagnostics and frontend tests overlapped part of the window; all retained measurements are resource observations, not browser SLA. Baseline initialization and each actual timed window are separate.
paired_latency: Alternating order controls on the same frozen fixture under contemporaneous load. Absolute SLA is checked by separate browser batches after extra stress stops.
